responsibility: C-family target hook support for NVPTX, specifically the preprocessor builtins exposed to source code. It defines architecture and mode macros such as __nvptx__, optional soft-stack and uniform-SIMT markers, the selected __PTX_SM__ level derived from nvptx-sm.def, and PTX ISA version major/minor macros, giving front ends target-specific compile-time visibility into the active NVPTX configuration.
